      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(top_left_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(top_middle_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(top_right_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_left_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_middle_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(middle_right_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_left_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_middle_square == 'b', 1, 0) + np.where(bottom_right_square == 'b', 1, 0)) / 9.0"

    {
      "name": "corner_occupancy_balance",
      "type": "formula",

        1

      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes corner influence in a normalized linear-friendly projection.",

      "uses_only_row_values": true,

        1
